purpose: New authorized current-development baseline; not historical proof for Task 328.

target.identityLimit: Endpoint fingerprint, not a historical platform instance ID.

priorRolledBackAttempt.reason: Diagnostic verifier incorrectly expected session index to omit recorded_at; actual migration SQL and catalog agree on (session_ref, recorded_at). No product or migration SQL change.

preflight.retryability: All names absent. IF NOT EXISTS is not a compatibility verifier; function/trigger replacement is transactional but requires a new preflight before any future replay.
preflight.safety: Only proof-specific trigger drops; no legacy table/data alteration. Unqualified references resolve in verified public-only effective schema. Default SECURITY INVOKER; privileged-owner bypass remains outside this baseline.

contentFingerprintMethod: Sorted SHA-256 of PostgreSQL to_jsonb(full row)::text in recorded session timezone; aggregate SHA-256 of the sorted digest array. No row contents or identifiers retained.

constraints.name: proof_ledger_events_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((decision_ref IS NULL) AND (event_type <> 'accepted-model-input'::text)) OR ((decision_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (event_type = 'accepted-model-input'::text))))

constraints.name: proof_user_decisions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((actor_kind = 'anonymous-session'::text) AND (session_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (actor_ref IS NULL)) OR ((actor_kind = 'authenticated'::text) AND (actor_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (session_ref IS NULL))))
